name: lds-monorepo
description: Lew Design System — components as plain HTML, CSS tokens, and the Open Icons sprite.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @lew/open-icons && node scripts/build-adherence.mjs && npm run docs
scripts.test: npm run test -w @lew/open-icons && node scripts/api-test.mjs && node scripts/css-test.mjs && node scripts/theme-source-test.mjs && node scripts/markup-contract-test.mjs && npm run typecheck && node scripts/consumer-test.mjs && npm run test -w @lew/lds-react && npm run test:site
scripts.test:site: npm run docs && node scripts/site-test.mjs && node scripts/card-contract.mjs && node scripts/card-interaction-test.mjs && node scripts/dom-test.mjs
